body:
Founder real-time: 'i don't see the robots tools in IDUNA' -- traced to S492's own named 'deeper gap': Role picked AI behavior, but which of the 5 robot models (Mannequin/Stan/Mike/Leela/George) a character rendered as was a pure connection-order round-robin with zero designer control. New AIKit enum, story_ai_spawn_enemy(kit) param, PlayerState.forced_kit + NetPlayer.forced_kit wire field (landed in a previously-wasted padding byte -- sizeof(NetPlayer) unchanged at 88), consumed at the top of draw_player_skin_mannequin's kit-selection cascade. SHANKPIT@d567232. Verified: make server/make lobby clean, story_ai_humanness_test passes, apps/tests/test_netcode.c's struct-layout checks pass, scripts/rl_env_packet.py's ctypes wire mirror updated and reverified against a real compiled C offsetof/sizeof probe (its own test suite, 34/34 pass).

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK-authored characters can choose their robot kit (S492)
